It was amongst the first companies to secure development rights for three dicovered oilfields in Gujarat: Bakrol, Lohar, and Karjisan, all with proven oil and gas reserves. SETL operates in the segment of Crude Oil and Natural Gas. Its crude oil is sold to refineries and its natural gas is consumed by local industry located around the vicinity of its fields.
